name: Create a community incident alert
description: Verifies a valid incident report is added to the community feed and retained after refresh.
steps: Enter title 'Suspicious activity near the park', choose Suspicious activity, add a description, and submit
Verify the new incident appears at the top of the feed
expected: The new incident appears in the feed with its category and description after refresh.

name: Attach a photo and location to a report
description: Verifies a report can include a selected image and a manually entered incident location.
steps: Enter 'Drieziek, near the community hall' as the location
expected: The incident is saved with the entered location and a photo indicator.

name: Filter the feed by incident category
description: Verifies category filters show matching incidents and can be reset.
steps: Verify only theft incidents are shown
expected: The feed shows only matching theft incidents, then returns to the full feed.

name: Reject an incomplete incident report
description: Verifies required incident details are validated on a mobile-sized viewport.
steps: Leave the title and description empty
expected: Validation feedback appears and no incomplete incident is added.

name: Post a community message
description: Verifies users can post a short community update from the mobile layout.
steps: Enter 'Please avoid the road by the shop while security checks the area.'
expected: The message appears in the community message list.
